title: The Loose Asset
author: Noor Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Sandoval, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
